source: read-only SELECT on lf_ops.reglas / reglas_pantallas / pg catalog
method: exact v1 pending marker regex and duplicate criteria + explicit backend/transversal
source_query:
WITH RECURSIVE
r AS (SELECT * FROM lf_ops.reglas WHERE estado IN ('VIGENTE','CANDIDATO')),
j(rid,path,val) AS (
 SELECT id,''::text,valor_config FROM r WHERE jsonb_typeof(valor_config) IN ('object','array')
 UNION ALL
 SELECT j.rid,j.path||'/'||e.k,e.v FROM j CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
 SELECT k,v FROM jsonb_each(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(j.val)='object' THEN j.val ELSE '{}'::jsonb END) o(k,v)
 UNION ALL SELECT (a.i-1)::text,a.v FROM jsonb_array_elements(CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(j.val)='array' THEN j.val ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) WITH ORDINALITY a(v,i)
 )e WHERE jsonb_typeof(j.val) IN ('object','array')
),
pr AS (SELECT rid,count(*)::int pm FROM j WHERE jsonb_typeof(val)='string'
 AND (val#>>'{}') ~* '(pending|pendiente)' AND path<>'/implementation_status'
 AND CASE WHEN (val#>>'{}') ~ '^PENDING_CANONICAL_' THEN 'CANONICAL_SOURCE'
 WHEN (val#>>'{}') ~* '^PENDING_.*(LEGAL|BUSINESS)' THEN 'LEGAL_BUSINESS'
 WHEN (val#>>'{}') ~* '^PENDING_.*COPY' THEN 'COPY'
 WHEN (val#>>'{}') ~* '^(PENDING|PENDIENTE)([_ ].*)?$' THEN 'OTHER_PENDING'
 ELSE 'STATE_WORD' END <> 'STATE_WORD' GROUP BY rid),
n AS (SELECT regla_id,count(DISTINCT pantalla_id)::int screens FROM lf_ops.reglas_pantallas GROUP BY 1),
raw AS (SELECT r.id,r.codigo,r.estado,r.categoria,r.es_transversal,COALESCE(n.screens,0) screens,
 NOT COALESCE(r.pendiente_decision,false) ok_dec,
 COALESCE(pr.pm,0)=0 ok_marker,
 NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(r.razon,'')),'') IS NOT NULL ok_reason,
 NOT (r.valor_config IS NOT NULL AND r.valor_config<>'{}'::jsonb AND EXISTS
 (SELECT 1 FROM lf_ops.reglas o WHERE o.id<>r.id AND o.estado IN('VIGENTE','CANDIDATO')
 AND o.categoria IS NOT DISTINCT FROM r.categoria AND o.valor_config=r.valor_config)) ok_dup,
 NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(r.valor_config->>'scope',r.valor_config->>'alcance',r.valor_config->>'aplica_a',r.valor_config->>'applies_to','')),'') scope_declared,
 NULLIF(btrim(coalesce(r.valor_config->>'tabla_afectada',r.valor_config->>'current_route_registry',r.valor_config->>'runtime_source',r.valor_config->>'canonical_table','')),'') obj_ref
 FROM r LEFT JOIN n ON n.regla_id=r.id LEFT JOIN pr ON pr.rid=r.id),
c AS (SELECT *,
 COALESCE(es_transversal,false) AND scope_declared IS NOT NULL
 AND scope_declared !~* '^(PENDING|UNRESOLVED|TBD|UNKNOWN)$' AS scope_transversal,
 CASE WHEN obj_ref ~ '^[a-z_][a-z0-9_]*[.][a-z_][a-z0-9_]*$'
 THEN to_regclass(obj_ref) IS NOT NULL ELSE false END AS scope_backend
 FROM raw),
v AS (SELECT *,
 CASE WHEN screens>=5 THEN 'FAST_5_PLUS'
 WHEN screens>=1 THEN 'SCREEN_LINK'
 WHEN scope_transversal THEN 'TRANSVERSAL_DECLARED'
 WHEN scope_backend THEN 'BACKEND_OBJECT_VERIFIED'
 ELSE 'SCOPE_REVIEW' END AS scope_route,
 (ok_dec AND ok_marker AND ok_reason AND ok_dup) AS quality_ok,
 ARRAY_REMOVE(ARRAY[
 CASE WHEN NOT ok_dec THEN 'NO_PENDING_DECISION' END,
 CASE WHEN NOT ok_marker THEN 'NO_PENDING_MARKER' END,
 CASE WHEN NOT ok_reason THEN 'HAS_STATED_REASON' END,
 CASE WHEN NOT ok_dup THEN 'NO_DUPLICATE_ACTIVE_RULE' END
 ]::text[],NULL) AS quality_failures
 FROM c)
SELECT id,codigo,estado,screens,scope_route,quality_ok,quality_failures,
 CASE WHEN NOT quality_ok THEN 'HOLD_CONTENT_FINDINGS'
 WHEN scope_route='SCOPE_REVIEW' THEN 'REVIEW_SCOPE'
 ELSE 'PASS' END AS vigente_verdict,
 (screens>=5 OR COALESCE(es_transversal,false)) policy_breadth_pass,
 (quality_ok AND screens>=5) fast_track,
 obj_ref AS backend_object_ref,
 scope_declared AS transverse_scope_ref
FROM v ORDER BY estado,id;
